name: Silk Folds
description: A length of silk lying in slow folds behind your content, drawn by a WebGL fragment shader; the pointer lifts the cloth beneath it.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the silk. It is mixed toward the background: pale by day, deep satin at night. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for how fast the folds travel and breathe. 0 holds them still; changes ease in.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the folds. 2 makes them twice as wide.

props.name: depth
props.description: Contrast of the folds, from 0 (flat cloth) to about 2 (deep, sharply lit folds).

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lift the cloth under the pointer, even through content. The bump trails the pointer and sinks away when it leaves.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the silk. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the silk. It stays selectable and clickable.
